## Load the 10X derived sequences :)

```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
E48.data <- Read10X(filepath_macos)
E48.ADT <- E48.data$`Antibody Capture`
Cells(E48.ADT) %>% length()
# Create Seurat Object using gene expression as main data
E48 = CreateSeuratObject(counts = E48.data$`Gene Expression`, project = "E48", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
# Create "Assay" of the Hashtags and Barcode Oligos
E48[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(E48.data[["Antibody Capture"]][, colnames(x = E48)])

DefaultAssay(E48) <- "RNA"
```

## Extract Hashtag barcodes

```{r HTODemultiplex, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# TotalSeqC Hashtag HTO demultiuplexig
E48.ADT <- t(E48.ADT)
E48.ADT <- as.matrix(E48.ADT)
E48.ADT.Hash <- E48.ADT[, c(4, 6, 8, 10)]
E48.ADT.Hash <- t(E48.ADT.Hash)

E48.ADT.Hash.sparse <- as(E48.ADT.Hash, "sparseMatrix")

E48.ADT.seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = E48.ADT.Hash.sparse, project = "E48", assay = "ADT")
E48_ADT <- NormalizeData(E48.ADT.seurat, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 1)
E48.demux <- HTODemux(E48_ADT, assay = "ADT", positive.quantile = 0.99)

E48.demux <- subset(E48.demux, cells = Cells(E48))

E48@meta.data[["Hashtag"]] <- E48.demux@meta.data[["ADT_maxID"]]


# dCODE HTO demultiuplexig
E48.ADT.dCODE <- E48.ADT[, c(1:3)]

E48.ADT.dCODE <-cbind(E48.ADT.dCODE, total = rowSums(E48.ADT.dCODE))

E48.ADT.dCODE <- subset.matrix(E48.ADT.dCODE, E48.ADT.dCODE[, 4] > 0)
E48.ADT.dCODE <- t(E48.ADT.dCODE[, c(1:3)])

E48.ADT.dCODE.sparse <- as(E48.ADT.dCODE, "sparseMatrix")

E48.ADT.dCODE.seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = E48.ADT.dCODE.sparse, project = "E48", assay = "ADT")
E48.ADT.dCODE.seurat <- NormalizeData(E48.ADT.dCODE.seurat, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 1)

E48.demux.dCODE <- HTODemux(E48.ADT.dCODE.seurat, assay = "ADT", positive.quantile = 0.5)

E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["ADT_classification"]]

E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("CA07_CA07", "CA07", E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])
E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("CA07_OVA", "CA07", E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])
E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("OVA_PR8", "OVA", E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])


E48 <- subset(E48, cells = Cells(E48.demux.dCODE))
E48.demux.dCODE <- subset(E48.demux.dCODE, cells = Cells(E48))

E48@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- E48.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]]

#E48_test <- t(data.frame(E48@assays[["ADT"]]@counts))
#E48_test <- as.data.frame(E48_test)
#E48_test <- E48_test %>% mutate(dCODE_sum = CA07 + PR8 + OVA)
#E48_test <- E48_test %>% mutate(binder = ifelse(dCODE_sum < 11, "None", "Binder"))
#E48@meta.data <- E48@meta.data %>% mutate(HA_binder_2 = ifelse(E48_test == "None", "No Binder", #E48@meta.data[["HA_binding"]]))

#E48@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] == E48@meta.data[["HA_binder_2"]]

remove(E48.ADT.dCODE, E48.ADT.dCODE.seurat, E48.ADT.dCODE.sparse, E48.ADT.Hash, E48.ADT.Hash.sparse, E48.ADT.seurat, E48.demux, E48.demux.dCODE, E48_ADT, E48.data, E48.ADT)
gc()

```

## Preprocessing of the Gene expression (GEX) data

```{r GEX, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Filter out based on feature counts
#VlnPlot(E48, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"),ncol = 2)
E48 <- subset(E48, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6500)
#E48
#~~~GENE EXPRESSION~~~

DefaultAssay(E48) <- "RNA"

# Normalize GEX data
E48_GEX <- NormalizeData(E48, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E48_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E48, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(E48_GEX), 10)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E48_GEX)
E48_GEX <- ScaleData(E48_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E48_GEX <- RunPCA(E48_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E48_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E48_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E48_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E48_GEX, dims = 1:10)
E48_GEX <- FindClusters(E48_GEX, resolution = 0.5)

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E48_GEX <- RunUMAP(E48_GEX, dims = 1:10)


# Doubletfinder
sweep.E48_GEX <- paramSweep_v3(E48_GEX, PCs = 1:15, sct = T)
sweep.E48_GEX <- summarizeSweep(sweep.E48_GEX, GT = F)
bcmvn_E48_GEX <- find.pK(sweep.E48_GEX)
pk_E48_GEX <- bcmvn_E48_GEX %>% filter(BCmetric == max(BCmetric)) %>% select(pK)
pk_E48_GEX <- as.numeric(as.character(pk_E48_GEX[[1]]))
(ggplot(bcmvn_E48_GEX, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) + geom_point() + geom_line() + theme_classic())

annotations_E48_GEX <- E48_GEX@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homo.prop_E48_GEX <- modelHomotypic(annotations_E48_GEX)
nExp_poi_E48_GEX <- round(0.08*nrow(E48_GEX@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj_E48_GEX <- round(nExp_poi_E48_GEX*(1-homo.prop_E48_GEX))

E48_GEX <- doubletFinder_v3(E48_GEX, PCs = 1:15, pN = 0.25, pK = pk_E48_GEX, nExp = nExp_poi_E48_GEX, reuse.pANN = F, sct = T)

E48_GEX_singlet <- subset(E48_GEX, cells=rownames(E48_GEX@meta.data)[which(E48_GEX@meta.data$DF.classification == "Singlet")])
#saveRDS(E48_GEX_singlet, file = paste(output_macos, 'E48_GEX.rds'))


# ~~~ Re-process the data after doublet removal ~~~
# Normalize GEX data
E48_GEX <- NormalizeData(E48_GEX_singlet, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E48_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E48_GEX_singlet, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E48_GEX)
E48_GEX <- ScaleData(E48_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E48_GEX <- RunPCA(E48_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E48_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E48_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E48_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E48_GEX, dims = 1:10)
E48_GEX <- FindClusters(E48_GEX, resolution = seq(0,1,by = 0.05))

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E48_GEX <- RunUMAP(E48_GEX, dims = 1:10)

# Run Clustree to better identify Clusters
clustree(E48_GEX)


E48_GEX <- FindClusters(E48_GEX, resolution = 0.025) #Good resotion for 2 clusters
E48_GEX[["old.idents"]] <- Idents(object = E48_GEX)

DimPlot(E48_GEX)
E48_GEX <- RenameIdents(E48_GEX, '0'='Memory B cells', '1' = 'GC B cells')
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E48_GEX_cluster.svg", sep = ""), plot = DimPlot(E48_GEX))

DefaultAssay(E48_GEX) <- "RNA"
E48_GEX.markers <- FindAllMarkers(E48_GEX, only.pos = F, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.2, verbose = F)
top20_E48_GEX <- E48_GEX.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC)
heatmap <- DoHeatmap(E48_GEX, features = top20_E48_GEX$gene, label = T)
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E48_heatmap.svg", sep = ''))
#E48_cellCycle <- CellCycleScoring(object = E48_GEX, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = TRUE)
saveRDS(E48_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Continue with the processing of Hashtag/Barcode (ADT) data

```{r ADT, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
E48_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
DefaultAssay(E48_GEX) <- "ADT"

# Adding the hashtags from CITE-Seq-count to the seurat object before continuing with the ADT processing
E48_GEX[["barcode"]] <- Cells(E48_GEX)
E48_hashtag.df <- read.csv(file = paste(output_macos, "E48_hashtags.csv", sep = ""))
DefaultAssay(E48_GEX) <- "ADT"
E48_hashtag.df$Barcode <- paste(E48_hashtag.df$Barcode, "-1", sep = "")

E48_hashtag_seurat.df <- subset(E48_hashtag.df, E48_hashtag.df$Barcode %in% Cells(E48_GEX))

E48_hashtag.df$Barcode %>% length()
E48_hashtag_seurat.df$Barcode %>% length()
Cells(E48_GEX) %>% length()
E48_GEX$barcode %>% length()

E48_GEX <- subset(E48_GEX, cells = E48_hashtag_seurat.df$Barcode)

E48_GEX@meta.data[["CITESeq_hashtag"]] <- E48_hashtag_seurat.df$Hashtag

# Normalize ADT data
E48_ADT <- NormalizeData(E48_GEX, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 2)

# Find highly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E48_ADT <- FindVariableFeatures(E48_ADT, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(E48_ADT), 10)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E48_ADT@assays[["ADT"]])
E48_ADT <- ScaleData(E48_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the ADT
E48_ADT <- RunPCA(E48_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Find dimensionality of ADT dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E48_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
Elbow

E48_ADT <- RunUMAP(E48_ADT, assay = 'ADT', dims = 1:5)
DimPlot(E48_ADT)
# Clustering and...→
E48_ADT <- FindNeighbors(E48_ADT, dims = 1:5)
E48_ADT <- FindClusters(E48_ADT, resolution = seq(0, 1 , by = 0.05))


clustree(E48_ADT)
E48_ADT <- FindClusters(E48_ADT, resolution = 0.1) #Maybe good cluster amount??
E48_ADT <- RenameIdents(E48_ADT, '0'='GC: PBS|PBS', '1' = 'MBC: PBS|CA07', '2'='GC: CA07|CA07', '3'='MBC: PBS|PBS', "4"="GC: PR8|CA07", "5"="MBC: CA07|CA07", "6"="MBC: PR8|CA07", "7"="GC: PBS|CA07")

ADT_plot <- DimPlot(E48_ADT, pt.size = 0.5)+theme(aspect.ratio=1)
ADT_plot <- ADT_plot + ggtitle('Hashtag/Bardoce clustering')
ADT_plot
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, 'E48-ADT-Cluster.svg', sep = ''), ADT_plot)

plot2 <- FeaturePlot(E48_ADT, features = E48_dCODE, pt.size = 0.2, keep.scale = 'all', order = TRUE) & theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
plot2

p3 <- FeaturePlot(E48_ADT, features = E48_group, pt.size = 0.2, order = TRUE) &theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 6), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank())+theme(aspect.ratio=1)
p3


saveRDS(E48_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Merging Seurat with BCR contig using scRepertoire

```{r scRepertoire, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
E48_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E48_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))


#Loading Contig file
E48_contigs <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/2_Ig_all_filtered_contigs/mouse_scseq_rep1_contigs.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t" )

E48_clonotypes <- E48_contigs

# Renaming MiXCR contig output to match 10X cellranger filtered contig annotations
E48_clonotypes <- E48_clonotypes %>% 
  mutate(chain = E48_clonotypes$chains) %>% 
  mutate(barcode = paste(E48_clonotypes$tagValueCELL, "-1", sep = "")) %>% 
  mutate(reads = E48_clonotypes$readCount) %>% 
  mutate(v_gene = E48_clonotypes$bestVGene) %>% 
  mutate(d_gene = E48_clonotypes$bestDGene) %>% 
  mutate(j_gene = E48_clonotypes$bestJGene) %>% 
  mutate(c_gene = E48_clonotypes$bestCGene)

colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR1"] = "fwr1_nt"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR2"] = "fwr2_nt"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR3"] = "fwr3_nt"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR4"] = "fwr4_nt"

colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1_nt"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2_nt"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3_nt"

colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR1"] = "fwr1"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR2"] = "fwr2"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR3"] = "fwr3"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR4"] = "fwr4"

colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2"
colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3"

colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "uniqueUMICount"] = "umis"

colnames(E48_clonotypes)[colnames(E48_clonotypes) == "targetSequences"] = "length"

E48_clonotypes <- E48_clonotypes %>% group_by(barcode) %>% mutate(contig_id=paste(barcode, "_contig_", row_number(), sep = ""))




#Adding contig BCR information to ADT seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E48_clonotypes, E48_ADT, group.by = "orig.ident")

combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85, removeNA = TRUE)
combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E48_ADT <- combineExpression(combined, E48_ADT, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE,
                  cloneTypes=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E48_ADT@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E48_ADT@active.ident)

slot(E48_ADT, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E48_ADT, "meta.data")$cloneType, 
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", 
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)", 
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", 
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)", 
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

saveRDS(E48_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))


#Adding contig BCR information to GEX seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E48_clonotypes, E48_GEX, group.by = "orig.ident")


combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85)
combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E48_GEX <- combineExpression(combined, E48_GEX, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE,
                  cloneTypes=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E48_GEX@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E48_GEX@active.ident)

slot(E48_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E48_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneType, 
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", 
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)", 
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", 
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)", 
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

# Highlighting clonotypes
Selected_clones <- c("CASGTLFDYW_CQQYSSYPYTF","CASRSSYYAMDYW_CHQWSSYPYTF", "CARKEGGYPFAYW_CLQHDEFPFTF", "CAKRGYTYYAMDYW_CLQHGESPYTF")

E48_ADT <- highlightClonotypes(E48_ADT, cloneCall = "aa", sequence = Selected_clones)
DimPlot(E48_ADT, group.by = "highlight", order = TRUE) + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", na.value = "grey")

E48_GEX <- highlightClonotypes(E48_GEX, cloneCall = "aa", sequence = Selected_clones)
DimPlot(E48_GEX, group.by = "highlight", order = TRUE) + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", na.value = "grey")

saveRDS(E48_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
saveRDS(E48_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Plotting with scRepertoire

```{r ChordDiagram, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE}
E48_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E48_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E48_ADT@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E48_ADT@active.ident)

grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E48_GEX@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E48_GEX@active.ident)


# Ova removed E48_testing
E48_ADT.noOVA <- subset(E48_ADT, HA_binding != "OVA")
circles.E48_ADT.noOVA <- getCirclize(E48_ADT.noOVA, 
                       group.by = "HA_binding")
chord <- circlize::chordDiagram(circles.E48_ADT.noOVA,
                       self.link = 1,
                       directional = 1,
                       symmetric = TRUE,
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)



### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on HA bindng
circles.ADT.HA <- getCirclize(E48_ADT, 
                       group.by = "HA_binding")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.HA,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Experimental groups
circles.ADT.ident <- getCirclize(E48_ADT, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Cell clusters
circles.GEX.ident <- getCirclize(E48_GEX, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.GEX.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)



### Clonal expansion overlayed on ADT clustering
DimPlot(E48_ADT, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 1) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")), 
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20)) &
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


### Clonal expansion overlayed on GEX clustering
DimPlot(E48_GEX, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 0.5) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")),
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


### Clonal expansion network overlayed on ADT clustering
clonalNetwork(E48_ADT, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              identity = "ident",
              filter.clones = NULL,
              filter.identity = NULL,
              cloneCall = "strict") & theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Clonal expansion network overlayed on GEX clustering
clonalNetwork(E48_GEX, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              identity = "ident",
              filter.clones = NULL,
              filter.identity = NULL,
              cloneCall = "strict") & theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Number of cells binned by clonal expansion by HA binding, GEX cluster, and ADT cluster
p1 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E48_GEX, x.axis = "HA_binding")
p2 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E48_GEX, x.axis = "ident")
p3 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E48_ADT, x.axis = "ident")

(p1 + NoLegend() | p2 + NoLegend() | p3) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 12))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)


combined.ADT <- expression2List(E48_ADT, 
                             split.by = "Hashtag")
combined.GEX <- expression2List(E48_GEX, 
                             split.by = "ident")
### Relative abundance
p1 <- clonalHomeostasis(combined.ADT, 
                  cloneCall = "strict", group.by = "Hashtag")
p2 <- clonalHomeostasis(combined.GEX, 
                  cloneCall = "strict")
(p1 + NoLegend() | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Occupied Reperoire space
p1 <- clonalProportion(combined.ADT, 
                 cloneCall = "aa")
p2 <- clonalProportion(combined.GEX, 
                 cloneCall = "aa")
clonalpropotionplot <- (p1 + NoLegend() | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)
clonalpropotionplot

#ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E48_clonalproportion.svg", sep = ""), plot = clonalpropotionplot)


### CLonal overlap
p1 <- clonalOverlap(combined.ADT, 
              cloneCall="aa", 
              method="overlap")
p2 <- clonalOverlap(combined.GEX, 
              cloneCall="aa", 
              method="overlap")
(p1 | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 15), axis.text = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)

```

## Manual mutation count on nucleotide level

```{r manualMutation, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
pattern <- "[SN][ACTGN][0-9]{2,3}[ACTGN]"

E48_contigs$nMutationsCDR1[is.na(E48_contigs$nMutationsCDR1)] <- 0
E48_contigs$nMutationsCDR2[is.na(E48_contigs$nMutationsCDR2)] <- 0
E48_contigs$nMutationsFR1[is.na(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR1)] <- 0
E48_contigs$nMutationsFR2[is.na(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR2)] <- 0
E48_contigs$nMutationsFR3[is.na(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR3)] <- 0
E48_contigs$nMutationsFR4[is.na(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR4)] <- 0

E48_contigs$totnMutationsCDR <- str_count(E48_contigs$nMutationsCDR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E48_contigs$nMutationsCDR2, pattern = pattern)

E48_contigs$totnMutationsFR <-  str_count(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR2, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR3, pattern = pattern) +
                                str_count(E48_contigs$nMutationsFR4, pattern = pattern)


## Mergin Contig mutations with Seurat object:

E48_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E48-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

E48_mutationList$FWR_mut <- E48_contigs$totnMutationsFR

Cells(E48_GEX) %>% length()
unique(E48_mutationList$tagValueCELL) %>% length()
```

## Subsetting data tables for plotting

```{r SubsetDF, echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
## Selecting only the top 100 expanded clonotypes

E48_clonotypes.sorted <- E48_contigs %>% group_by(cloneId) %>% add_tally(sort = TRUE, name = "expansion") #sort by number of contigs in clonotypes
E48_clonotypes.sorted <- E48_clonotypes.sorted %>% group_by(IMGT_VGene) %>% add_tally() # Add the number of contigs

E48_clonotypes.top100 <- E48_clonotypes.sorted %>% mutate(group_num = as.integer(factor(cloneId, levels = unique(.$cloneId)))) %>% filter(group_num < 51) # Select the top 100 clonotypes

# Change the order of infection and HA binding for plots
E48_clonotypes.top100$infection <- factor(E48_clonotypes.top100$infection, levels = rev(c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")))
E48_clonotypes.top100$HA_binding <- factor(E48_clonotypes.top100$HA_binding, levels = rev(c("CA07", "CA07+PR8", "PR8", "OVA")))


# Select only the Heavy Chains clonotypes
E48_clonotypes.sorted.HC <- E48_clonotypes.sorted %>% filter(chains == "IGH")

E48_clonotypes.HC.top100 <- E48_clonotypes.sorted.HC %>% mutate(group_num = as.integer(factor(cloneId, levels = unique(.$cloneId)))) %>% filter(group_num < 101)

# Change the order of infection and HA binding for plots
E48_clonotypes.HC.top100$infection <- factor(E48_clonotypes.HC.top100$infection, levels = rev(c("PBS;PBS", "PBS;CA07", "CA07;CA07", "PR8;CA07")))
E48_clonotypes.HC.top100$HA_binding <- factor(E48_clonotypes.HC.top100$HA_binding, levels = rev(c("CA07", "CA07+PR8", "PR8", "OVA")))

# Select the top 100 expanded clones from AIRR table
E48_AIRR_HC.Top100 <- E48_AIRR_HC.subset %>% filter(sequence_id %in% E48_clonotypes.HC.top100$cloneId)


# Select only double binders
temp <- E48_clonotypes.sorted.HC %>% filter(HA_binding == "CA07+PR8")
E48_AIRR_HC.Double <- E48_AIRR_HC.subset %>% filter(sequence_id %in% temp$cloneId)

# Select only CA07
temp <- E48_clonotypes.sorted.HC %>% filter(HA_binding == "CA07")
E48_AIRR_HC.CA07 <- E48_AIRR_HC.subset %>% filter(sequence_id %in% temp$cloneId)

# Select only PR8
temp <- E48_clonotypes.sorted.HC %>% filter(HA_binding == "PR8")
E48_AIRR_HC.PR8 <- E48_AIRR_HC.subset %>% filter(sequence_id %in% temp$cloneId)


# Sort by Mutation rate
E48_obs_HC.topMutation <- E48_obs_HC %>% mutate(total_mut = mu_count_cdr_r + mu_count_cdr_s + mu_count_fwr_r + mu_count_fwr_s) %>% arrange(total_mut) %>% top_n(100)
```

```{r}
Bulk <- readRDS("/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/Bioinformatics/data_all_bulk.RDS")
SingleCell <- readRDS("/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/Bioinformatics/data_all_sc.RDS")
```

```{r Alt HA assignments E48_testing}
PR8cells <- WhichCells(E48_ADT, expression = CA07 < 1.2 & PR8 >= 1.5)

Negcells <- WhichCells(E48_ADT, expression = CA07 < 1.2 & PR8 < 1.5)
```
